provenance.paper_title: MobileUse: A GUI Agent with Hierarchical Reflection for Autonomous Mobile Operation

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Self-planned exploration builds reusable knowledge of unfamiliar mobile environments.

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Action-, trajectory-, and global-level reflection retain task progress and error evidence.

Proactive exploration converts interactions into reusable app knowledge. For MobileUse, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of proactively explored app knowledge.
Hierarchical reflectors detect and recover from errors under fixed triggers. For MobileUse, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of proactively explored app knowledge.
During operation, MobileUse applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to proactively explored app knowledge; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (proactively explored app knowledge) changes through abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, fixed-rule correction of stored state, fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
